Title: Tanay and the Family

Cast

1. Tanay - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Aditi - 10 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Sonali - 36 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Ayaan - 12 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
5. Vimla - 66 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Vimla stand near him.]

Tanay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay dances to the music.]

Vimla (softly): "One more time!"

[Tanay nods.]

Vimla: "One more time!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Tanay: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay puts on his school uniform.]

Sonali: "Mother, look at this."

[Tanay combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Tanay: "One more time!"

[Tanay puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Tanay (softly): "Hey, look at that!"

[Aditi puts on red lipstick.]

Aditi (softly): "Show me too!"

[Aditi puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Aditi (gently): "I'm ready!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Thick fog lies all around. Tanay stands in the courtyard. Sonali, Ayaan and Vimla stand near him.]

Sonali: "So, here we are!"

[The mist slowly clears.]

Tanay (happily): "I'm ready!"

Scene 4: The snowy hillside - Day

Tanay: "Mom, look over here."

[Tanay makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Ayaan (excited): "That's easy."

[Tanay builds a snowman.]

Sonali: "Careful!"

[Tanay slides down the snowy slope.]

Tanay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
